title: TLSNotary
description: Opt-in private TLSNotary browser-extension capture. Adds MPC computation, bandwidth and seconds or minutes to archiving. The public verifier sees destination hostname, sizes and timing, plus a fixed HTTP protocol marker, but receives no URL path/query, cookies or page content. A compact signed receipt authenticates the separately replayed main response saved by this plugin; other archive outputs are not automatically certified.

TLSNOTARY_ENABLED.description: Enable private extension proofs; significantly increases archiving time and bandwidth.

TLSNOTARY_VERIFIER_URL.description: Verifier and signed-receipt service. HTTP is permitted only for local development.

TLSNOTARY_TRUSTED_KEY.description: Independently trusted Ed25519 public key (base64 SPKI); empty uses the bundled service key.

TLSNOTARY_TIMEOUT.description: Hard per-capture deadline in seconds; no retries or effect on other plugins.

TLSNOTARY_MAX_RECV_BYTES.description: Maximum complete HTTP response bytes. Oversized pages fail explicitly; assets and video streams are excluded.

TLSNOTARY_MAX_SENT_BYTES.description: Maximum authenticated request bytes including Chrome cookies/headers.
